lines.text: I brief everyone on the Ark's current situation.
Most of the issues within the Ark have been resolved, but as a consequence, the Ark's power source is nearing the end of its lifespan.
That end is closer than we think.
The Queen has also begun targeting the Ark directly.
She has even resorted to deploying chemical weapons. It is clear she is intent on destroying the Ark.
Humanity can no longer afford to remain underground in the Ark.
Whether we like it or not, we have no choice but to launch the Third Surface Reclamation War.
The Third Surface Reclamation War that will be an all-out war against the Queen.
And...
... Dorothy may be the one leading the charge.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h_no
lines.text: ... Dorothy?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: That's right. She would become the symbol of the Third Surface Reclamation War.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Of course, if Dorothy refuses, there's nothing we can do about it.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: ... Personally, I think she'll do it.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Yes. I think so too.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: ... Why is that?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: The malice is gone.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h_no
lines.text: ... What?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: The malice in her eyes is gone.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: I don't know the reason, but that's the feeling I got.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Yeah. It felt like something had been resolved.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Aren't we going off nothing but a hunch here?

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: When it comes to complicated matters, there's nothing as reliable as intuition.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: That's true.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h_no
lines.text: Dorothy... at the forefront of the Third Surface Reclamation War...

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Does that mean she's forgiven the Ark?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: That was the impression I got.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: ... That's hard to believe.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: She didn't look like she'd lost all hope after running out of places to turn?
No. I'm certain of that.
You seem happy, Snow White.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h_no
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h_no
lines.text: Because I'd given up hope.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h_no
lines.text: I thought Dorothy would never fight for humanity again.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h_no
lines.text: But now...
Snow White stares intently at us.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h_no
lines.text: ... Thanks.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: You don't have to thank us for anything.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: It was Dorothy's choice, after all.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: So, what exactly are you getting at?

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Are you asking Eden to join the Ark's Third Surface Reclamation War?

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: I already told you. We won't rely on the Ark.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: There you go with that foolish talk again.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Surely you understand the situation we're in, Johan?

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: This is not the time to cling to your pride.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: My decision hasn't changed.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Honestly, you're acting like a child.
Oh, I didn't come to Eden seeking help for the Ark.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: ... Then what?
The Ark will help Eden.
Eden will proceed with its original goal of capturing the Queen.
In turn, the Ark will help Eden on its own terms.
The Ark intends to benefit from Eden's extensive combat experience during its time on the surface over the years.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: You're just twisting the wording.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: You say that, but you certainly look more relaxed.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: ... Be quiet.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: New Hope was easier to convince than I thought.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Yeah, I'm surprised how easily things settled.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: The tougher a hero acts, the easier he is to win over.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: I can hear everything you're saying. And I'm not a hero.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Very well. I'll accept your proposition for now.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Then allow me to explain the current situation in Eden and on the surface.
We listen to Johan's briefing.
About Nayuta's corruption.
The newborn Raptures.
The new Heretic imitating Scarlet and Isabel.
An unknown entity called Mirror.
Rose, Scarlet's older sister.
Liberalio, betrayed and decapitated.
Red Shoes, one of the second-generation Grimms models.
The Queen who invaded the Imitation Ark to secure Dark Matter.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Newborn Raptures are gathering near the Lift. Or rather, it'd be more accurate to say they're being created there.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: We've confirmed that the black pools we've been seeing everywhere are Dark Matter.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: It appears that after securing the massive stockpiles of Dark Matter stored at Four Beasts' base, the Imitation Ark, the Queen seems to be accelerating production of newborn Raptures.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Anyone can see they are preparing for all-out war.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: ... Also, judging by the incident with the Heretic, Annihilio,

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: it's certain that they are amassing their forces to strike the Ark.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: The Queen is being cautious. I had assumed it was out of fear, but I was wrong.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: The fact that she dropped chemical weapons on the Ark proves that.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: She used a lethal weapon to gauge how strong the Ark is at present.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: She must have realized that it's impossible to wipe us out without unleashing her full power.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: It's safe to assume she's making thorough preparations for precisely that.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: What about the possibility of an attack on Eden?

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: ... There's none.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Infuriating as it is, there hasn't been a single additional raid since that day.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Besides, our forces were annihilated after the battle with the Queen.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: From her perspective, we're no longer a threat worth worrying about.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: If anything, the only thing she'd likely be wary of is Eden's Spear.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: We pose no threat if left alone.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: So there's no reason to send troops toward Eden's Spear just to eliminate us.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: It would be easier for the Queen to resolve the situation by drawing us out.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: But... she hasn't even bothered with such provocations. The Queen clearly doesn't consider us worthy of her attention.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: In her eyes, we're merely a peripheral faction with nothing to show for beyond our formidable defensive armaments.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: We're something she'll finish off later on the side, after taking care of more pressing matters.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: ... It stings, but it's true.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: {AccountData.NickName}. How long do you estimate it will take before the Third Surface Reclamation War begins?
We're expediting preparations as much as possible, but it won't be anytime soon.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: In the meantime, they'll continue steadily building up their forces.
Johan looks around.
He gazes at the Four Beasts, the Counters, and Snow White.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: ... I want to propose a preemptive strike.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Papillon and Ziz's reconnaissance confirmed that something is happening at the Lift.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: A massive amount of Dark Matter has adhered to the Lift.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: It's safe to assume they're creating something.
If it's another Heretic like Annihilio, our chances of victory will only grow slimmer.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Precisely. The Queen is preparing for a war, not merely a battle.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: The Heretic Annihilio is a prime example of that.
What is the objective of the preemptive strike?
An all-out war with just our current forces is impossible. We have almost no chance of winning.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: We confirm the status of the Lift, and if possible, strike or destroy it.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: If we can rescue the Monk in the process, we will.
Is that all?

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Johan. Be honest with us.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: It's a declaration of war.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: A message to that arrogant creature who trampled us beneath her feet and doesn't even spare us a second thought.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: We'll show her not to underestimate us.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: All right. If that's the reason, I'm convinced.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Yeah. We gotta knock that arrogant punk down a peg.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: They were the ones who launched the ambush! Let's give them a taste of their own medicine.
All right. Let's do it.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: ... Well then.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: You could at least say thank you. Honestly, there's barely anyone here representing Eden.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: I'm right here, you know.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: You're just backup.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: ... Oh, right. I figured you'd say that.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: We might be able to win if we use the child.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Who? The Commander's and my child?

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: ... Why does it annoy me so much whenever you keep bringing that up?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Yes. After all, she once overpowered the Queen who had taken control of Liliweiss's body.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: If we use her, we can win.

lines.speaker: onlyone
lines.text: Huh... g...

lines.speaker: onlyone
lines.text: Hug... me...
No. I don't want her to fight anymore.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: ... Why?
She's just a little girl who likes being held.
I want her to grow up like a normal child.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Wow, just wow...

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: Did you two rehearse this beforehand? I, the brilliant Bahamut, won't be deceived.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Fine. Since you're the one saying it, I suppose it must be true.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I'll get ready. Let me know when the time comes.
Leviathan leaves the meeting room with a nonchalant expression.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Still utterly devoid of manners, as always.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: She's acting that way because she's grateful. She's just running off because she's embarrassed.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Y-yeah. Levi said the same thing.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: She hopes the child doesn't become a monster...

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Then we'll go get some rest too. Gotta stock up on more apples.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Um... th-then I'll go take a bath.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: I shall read a book. Even I, the wise Bahamut, know it's impossible to read while fighting a battle.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: We're still in the middle of our briefing.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Whatever. What you expect from us is simple, isn't it?

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: A complex operation wouldn't work, since neither side knows the other well enough.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: So, all we have to do is go there and wipe them out. Right?

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: There you go. Then we'll go get some rest.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Come visit if you get bored, Young Man. You hear?
Sure. Get some rest.
The Four Beasts leave the meeting room.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: ... What a self-centered bunch.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: They're awfully docile for Heretics, though.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Yes, that's true.
Scarlet, Rapunzel... and Noah... it'll be difficult for them to join the fight, won't it?

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Yes, it would be impossible for now.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: That Nikke manufacturing technology you secured for us... Oh, thank you for providing us with such highly classified information. My thanks are long overdue.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Anyway, it's taking some time to set up the equipment needed for production.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: I expect we'll be able to proceed immediately once the setup is complete.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h_no
lines.text: ... Good. Glad to hear it.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: That brings me to my point, Johan. I'd like you to set the priorities.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: What priorities?

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: We can only complete setup for up to two pieces of equipment.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: In other words, I'm asking you to choose who to save first.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: ... Rapunzel, Scarlet, then Noah.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Such a cold, rational assessment.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Understood. We'll proceed in that order.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: I have one suggestion and one issue to bring up related to this.
